yt_title.hi: January mein gym full, March mein khaali? Gym owners ki 3 problems #shorts
yt_title.en: Packed in January, empty by March: 3 gym owner problems #shorts

yt_description.hi: Membership renewals, members jo aana band kar dete hain, aur Instagram enquiries: gym ki 3 problems aur unke fix. Concept demo: Forge Fitness.
yt_description.en: Missed renewals, members who quietly stop coming, and slow Instagram replies: three gym problems and their fixes. Concept demo: Forge Fitness.

ig_caption.hi:
January mein gym full. March mein khaali kyun? 🏋️

1️⃣ Membership khatam, renew ka reminder nahi
✅ Fix: automatic WhatsApp reminder + UPI renew link

2️⃣ Member 2 hafte se nahi aaya, kisi ko pata nahi
✅ Fix: QR check-in + roz subah 'kaun nahi aaya' list

3️⃣ Instagram par price poocha, reply agle din
✅ Fix: website par plans, prices, free trial booking 24x7

Forge Fitness ek concept demo hai. Apne gym ke liye chahiye? Comment karo GYM 👇

Voiceover is AI-generated.
ig_caption.en:
Packed in January. Empty by March. Why? 🏋️

1️⃣ Memberships run out and nobody asks to renew
✅ Fix: automatic WhatsApp reminders + a UPI renew link

2️⃣ A member stops coming and nobody notices
✅ Fix: QR check-in + a daily 'who stopped coming' list

3️⃣ Price questions on Instagram get answered tomorrow
✅ Fix: plans, prices and free-trial booking on your website, 24x7

Forge Fitness is a concept demo. Want this for your gym? Comment GYM 👇

Voiceover is AI-generated.

say.hi: January में gym भर जाता है। March में खाली क्यों हो जाता है?
say.en: In *January* the gym is packed. Why is it empty by *March*?

show.hi: *January* mein gym bhar jaata hai. *March* mein khaali kyun ho jaata hai?

say.hi: पहली problem: membership खत्म हो गई, और किसी ने renew करने को बोला ही नहीं।
say.en: Problem one: a *membership* ran out, and nobody asked them to *renew*.

show.hi: Pehli problem: *membership* khatam ho gayi, aur kisi ne *renew* karne ko bola hi nahi.

say.hi: Fix: expiry से पहले automatic WhatsApp reminder, और एक link से UPI पर renew।
say.en: The fix: an *automatic* WhatsApp reminder before expiry, and one *link* to *renew* by UPI.

show.hi: Fix: expiry se pehle *automatic* WhatsApp reminder, aur ek *link* se UPI par *renew*.

msgs.t: Hi Rohan, your plan ends on 28 Nov. Renew in one tap: forge.fit/renew

say.hi: दूसरी problem: member दो हफ्ते से नहीं आया, और किसी को पता ही नहीं।
say.en: Problem two: a member hasn't come in for *two weeks*, and *nobody noticed*.

show.hi: Doosri problem: member *do hafte* se nahi aaya, aur kisi ko *pata hi nahi*.

say.hi: Fix: QR से check-in, और हर सुबह एक list: कौन नहीं आया, उसे call करो।
say.en: The fix: *QR* check-in, and a *list* every morning of who stopped coming, so you can *call* them.

show.hi: Fix: *QR* se check-in, aur har subah ek *list*: kaun nahi aaya, use *call* karo.

say.hi: तीसरी problem: Instagram पर पूछा price क्या है, और reply अगले दिन गया।
say.en: Problem three: someone asked your *price* on Instagram, and the reply went out *the next day*.

show.hi: Teesri problem: Instagram par poocha *price* kya hai, aur reply *agle din* gaya.

say.hi: Fix: website पर plans, prices और free trial booking, चौबीस घंटे।
say.en: The fix: *plans*, *prices* and *free trial* booking on your website, twenty-four hours a day.

show.hi: Fix: website par *plans*, *prices* aur *free trial* booking, chaubees ghante.

say.hi: Renewals, check-in, enquiries, तीनों एक system में।
अपने gym के लिए ये चाहिए? Comment करो GYM, या DM करो।
say.en: Want this for your *gym*? Comment *GYM* or send us a *DM*.

show.hi: Apne *gym* ke liye ye chahiye? Comment karo *GYM*, ya *DM* karo.
